changelog:
Initial release of **code-review-guide**.

- Provides a structured, prioritized framework for reviewing code changes (pull requests or diffs).
- Emphasizes correctness, security, and design review before style.
- Outputs comments ranked by severity (blocking, should-fix, nit) with clear “why” and suggestions.
- Includes guidance for effective, kind feedback: highlight what’s done well and always give a clear verdict.
- Details anti-patterns to avoid and best practices based on senior code review standards.
summary: Review a pull request or diff like a thoughtful senior engineer — prioritized, kind, and focused on what matters. Use when reviewing code, giving PR feedback...
